Two tiers: $400 for Business Essentials ($5,000 new-money deposit within 30 days, $5,000 balance maintained for 60 days); $1,200 for Platinum Business Checking ($25,000 new-money deposit within 30 days, $25,000 balance maintained for 60 days). Both tiers require six qualifying transactions within 60 days.
New money must come from outside U.S. Bank — transfers from another U.S. Bank product or affiliate do not count.

Qualifying transactions: debit card purchases, ACH/wire credits or debits, Zelle credits/debits, mobile check deposit, check debits, business bill pay, Payment Solutions receipts. NOT eligible: person-to-person payments, credit card transfers, transfers between U.S. Bank accounts.

New business checking customers only; existing businesses with a business checking account, or one closed within the past 12 months, do not qualify. Limit one bonus per business; cannot be combined with other business checking bonus offers.
Bonus is deposited into the new business checking account 30 days following the last calendar day of the month after qualifications are met.

$25 minimum deposit to open (a deposit, not a fee). Platinum has a $30 monthly maintenance fee (waivable with $25,000 average balance, Payment Solutions, or $75,000 combined balances); Business Essentials has a $0 monthly fee.
Promo code Q3DIR26 is automatically applied on the promo page (some U.S. Bank disclosure pages reference Q3DIG26 — use the code shown during application).
